about: Round 1041: the sources behind src/lib/soccerCareerCup.ts DOMESTIC_CUPS, window by window. Every NAMED and NONE window cites facts that two non-Wikipedia sources back, each with its URL, the line read and the read date; an UNKNOWN window cites what made it unknown (or nothing, when nothing was read).
